market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$77K. To dip to $45K requires ~42% drawdown by Dec 31 2026. Possible in a bear market continuation but represents significant further decline beyond consensus low estimates of $60-75K.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro shock (recession, crypto event) drives a true bear market low
